Hall of fame

  • Home
  • Hall of fame

Welcome to our Hall of Fame! The place where we honour all those individuals, researchers and organisations who selflessly help our community of Union institutions, bodies, offices and agencies improve their cybersecurity posture by reporting security issues and vulnerabilities they discover in the wild. And it can get really wild, believe us! Here is a shoutout to all of you white hats out there… We salute you and we appreciate you!

Interesting in reporting and making it to our Hall of Fame? Then please read our Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure Policy and send your finding at services@cert.europa.eu! Thanks!
